{{Quote|The TIEs lasted two minutes. I watched the Battle Dragons' turbolasers lance out, brilliant green, searching in the darkness. I watched the Hapan gunners find the range, begin to turn TIEs into flowers of flames. I watched fighters wheel around for another pass, their laser bolts sparking useless blue spirals and whorls off the Hapan shields. Then they were all dead, and it was our turn.|Grand Admiral Osvald Teshik remembers the Battle of Andalia|<ref name="TEGTW" />}}
The '''Battle of Andalia''' was an engagement between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], in the [[Andalia system/Legends|Andalia system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Imperial [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] sent [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Osvald Teshik]] to the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] as the head of a [[Battle group/Legends|task force]], led by the [[Pursuit-class light cruiser|''Pursuit''-class light cruiser]] ''[[Shepherd]]'', on a doomed mission as a lesson for the other Grand [[Admiral/Legends|Admirals]] after Teshik previously [[Capture of Coh Veshiv|failed him]]. Facing a [[Hapan]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] composed of five [[Hapan Battle Dragon]]s and eight [[Nova-class battle cruiser|''Nova''-class battle cruisers]], Teshik's task force was heavily mauled, resulting in the loss of the entire battle group, save for Teshik, who managed to survive.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|But he was angry that your privateers had been running wild in the core, and that they'd kidnapped that swollen gasbag Advisor Veshiv from Esseles. Since I commanded that oversector, I had to sate his anger.|Grand Admiral Osvald Teshik, on Emperor Palpatine's reason for sending him to Andalia|<ref name="TEGTW" />}}
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] allied with the Rebels [[Capture of Coh Veshiv|captured]] [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Coh Veshiv]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. Because Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Osvald Teshik]] commanded the [[Oversector/Legends|oversector]] where the event took place<ref name="TEGTW" /> and failed to deal with these raiders, Imperial [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] used Teshik as an example to teach the other Grand [[Admiral/Legends|Admirals]] a lesson.<ref name="Who">{{InsiderCite|66|Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals}}</ref> Palpatine sent Teshik and a [[Battle group/Legends|task force]] comprised of the [[Pursuit-class light cruiser|''Pursuit''-class light cruiser]] ''[[Shepherd]]'', carrying two [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], and eight [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] on a doomed mission to the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

Though most of the task force believed their mission was a recon patrol, with a purpose of keeping the [[near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Hapan]]s honest, Teshik knew that none of them would survive the mission's conclusion. After arriving in the [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]], the task force proceeded to the [[Andalia system/Legends|Andalia system]] after being ordered to engage the enemy forces there.<ref name="TEGTW" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Six of the gunships were gone inside a minute, vaporized by the battle cruisers. The captains of the last two gunships panicked. They collided head on.|Teshik thinks back on the events of the battle|<ref name="TEGTW" />}}
Upon reaching the Andalia system, the Imperial task force faced a tipped-off [[Hapan Royal Navy|Hapan fleet]], composed of five [[Hapan Battle Dragon]]s and eight [[Nova-class battle cruiser|''Nova''-class battle cruisers]]. Although the Imperials faced long odds and many expected the task force to flee, Teshik had a [[Unidentified Imperial deck officer (Shepherd)|deck officer]] launch the TIEs to engage the enemy at the start of the battle. Lasting just two [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] before both squadrons were eradicated by Battle Dragon [[Turbolaser/Legends|laser fire]], the TIEs managed to make two passes, though their weaponry was unable to penetrate the enemy [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. The eight Imperial gunships were also quickly destroyed, six being annihilated within a [[Standard minute/Legends|minute]] before the last two gunships crashed into each other head-on after their [[Captain/Legends|captains]] panicked.<ref name="TEGTW" />

The ''Shepherd'' was the last Imperial [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to fall to the Hapans. The shields of the ''Pursuit''-class [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] failed, and after a volley of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] launched by the lead Battle Dragon struck the ship, the ''Shepherd''{{'s}} [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]] blew, destroying the cruiser. However, Teshik managed to make it out of the ''Shepherd'' before the ship was lost, donning an [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suit]] due to his failure of finding an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. He was ejected from the cruiser by a hull breach, though the survival suit was damaged in the process.<ref name="TEGTW" />

==The aftermath==
[[File:GATeshik-SWI66.png|thumb|left|150px|Grand Admiral Osvald Teshik, after receiving cybernetics replacements]]
{{Quote|The only survivor of the Battle of Andalia was the man sent there to die.|Osvald Teshik recalls what happened after the Imperial defeat at Andalia|<ref name="TEGTW" />}}
In the wake of the Hapan victory, Teshik had a vision regarding the nature of war over the [[Time/Legends|centuries]]. Later, Teshik was picked up by an Imperial [[snoopship]] sent by the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] to ensure that Palpatine's sentence was carried out after Teshik managed to activate a [[Distress beacon/Legends|beacon]] on his suit. However, due to the damaged suit, only a quarter of Teshik's body survived, the rest being replaced with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]]. In the end, Teshik, the man sent by the Emperor to [[Death/Legends|die]] at Andalia, survived.<ref name="TEGTW" />

Teshik later recounted the details of the battle to his captors after he was captured by Rebels following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. He was then executed for war crimes.<ref name="TEGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I was struck, as tons of folks have been before, by its mix of beauty and despair &ndash; a sort of bleak transcendence. By the end of the song I knew what I wanted &ndash; an officer bearing witness to scenes that were terrible and yet somehow beautiful, and led to a strange vision.|Author Jason Fry describes the origins of the details involving the Battle of Andalia after listening to Leonard Cohen's ''Hallelujah''|<ref name="Endnotes">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/20843004826/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-1|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 1}}</ref>}}
The Battle of Andalia was first mentioned in [[2003]]'s ''[[Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals]]'', a section written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Abel G. Peña]] in the [[Star Wars Insider 66|66th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine.<ref name="Who" /> A detailed description was not published until [[2012]] in the ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]. ''Warfare'' was the first source to identify the battle as the Battle of Andalia, and it used the section containing the battle as the prologue of the book.<ref name="TEGTW" />

Fry later wrote in his [http://jasonfry.tumblr.com/post/20843004826/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-1 endnotes] about the creation of the section that described the battle. Originally, instead of the prologue containing details of the battle, it had Imperial Admiral [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]], [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] and [[Architect/Legends|architect]] [[Bevel Lemelisk]], as well as Imperial [[General/Legends|General]] and [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Insmot Bowen]] discussing in a briefing an ancient war between the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]] and the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]]. However, Fry's editor, [[Erich Schoeneweiss]], felt the prologue needed to be a more engaging introduction to the book, and have some actual warfare in it, which was why the battle replaced the briefing. Fry later got inspiration for the battle and its consequences when he listened to the song "[[Wikipedia:Hallelujah (Leonard Cohen song)|Hallelujah]]," by [[Wikipedia:Leonard Cohen|Leonard Cohen]].<ref name="Endnotes" />
